notes: Vodafone Cash product mechanics (6-digit PIN, *9*5# activation) are captured in agent_banking.json and fees.json rather than duplicated here. Fawry publishes no transaction fee for bill payment, so products.json carries no Fawry pricing.

entries.subject: ipn_launch_date
entries.quote: The Instant Payment Network (IPN) is a national network linking all operating banks within the Arab Republic of Egypt that has launched on March 22, 2022
entries.notes: CBE and EBC both give 22 March 2022; AfricaNenda describes it as launched in 2022.

entries.subject: ipa_address_format
entries.display: Instant Payment Address looks like name@InstaPay
entries.quote: An Instant Payment Address "IPA" is a simplified address for your account (name@InstaPay).
entries.notes: Closed set for the alias type: mobile number, IPA (name@InstaPay), IBAN/account number, card number.

entries.subject: self_onboarding
entries.display: InstaPay onboarding needs no signed paperwork
entries.quote: No need to sign any papers
entries.notes: Onboarding still requires the account to be verified against the issuing bank's records.

entries.subject: multi_bank_aggregation
entries.value_text: all of the customer's linked bank accounts in one app
entries.display: One app holds all linked bank accounts
entries.quote: InstaPay is an app that allows direct access to all your bank accounts and transfer instantly using your mobile device 24/7.
entries.notes: InstaPay is one of only three African instant payment systems with a direct consumer app (AfricaNenda).

entries.subject: card_transfer_without_account_number
entries.value_text: transfer to any debit, credit or prepaid card number
entries.display: Card-number transfers work without the beneficiary's account details
entries.quote: With InstaPay, you can transfer instantly to any Card number by just using the card number and cardholder name. ( Debit, Credit or prepaid card)
entries.notes: Closed set: debit only / credit only / debit, credit or prepaid. Answer: debit, credit or prepaid.

entries.subject: meeza_scheme_status
entries.value_text: national payment scheme under CBE supervision
entries.display: Meeza is Egypt's national card scheme, supervised by the CBE
entries.quote: Meeza is the Egyptian National Payment Scheme developed under the supervision of the Central Bank of Egypt, that enables ﬁnancial institutions to meet the needs of consumers who expect to make payments and access funds wherever, whenever and however they choose.
entries.notes: EBC states the National Payment Council decreed the scheme in 2017 and EBC operates it; the meeza-eg.com page gives no date, so effective_from is the 2017 decree year.

entries.subject: meeza_card_count
entries.notes: Scheme's own 'Meeza in numbers' block; no date on the page. EBC separately claims more than 35 million cardholders, which is a different measure. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: meeza_atm_count
entries.notes: Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: fawry_pay_reference_code
entries.value_text: FawryPay reference code paid in the myfawry app
entries.display: A FawryPay reference code is settled inside the myfawry app
entries.quote: If you receive a FawryPay reference code to complete a payment transaction from any of our partners. - You can pay it through myfawry app at your convenience.
entries.notes: The reference code is the bill identifier a merchant issues; it is not a wallet number. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: fawry_payment_channels
entries.value_text: ATMs, mobile wallets, Fawry Plus stores and retail POS
entries.display: Fawry bills can be paid by ATM, wallet, Fawry Plus store or retail POS
entries.quote: Fawry services are also available through:** - **ATMs** - In collaboration with certain banks, Fawry offers a cardless service, where you have access to various Fawry services through the banks’ ATMs. - **Mobile Wallets** - In collaboration with certain banks, Fawry services are offered through the banks’ digital wallets.
entries.notes: Cardless ATM access is offered in collaboration with banks; retail terminals are certified by Visa and Mastercard. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).
